# Vasilis Totskas — Fullstack Developer

> Personal portfolio of Vasilis Totskas, a fullstack developer based in Athens, Greece. He develops applications for web, desktop and mobile, and builds the infrastructure that runs them.

Working professionally since 2020 at Advisable, where he started as an intern and is a web developer today. Since August 2026 he is also serving his military service as a full stack engineer in the Greek Army (ΚΕ.Π.Υ.Ε.Σ.), working with FastAPI and Angular. He holds a Computer Engineering degree from the University of Western Macedonia and is certified by Google and TestDome. He works in English and Greek, and the site is published in both.

The work groups into four layers. Interface: Vue.js, Nuxt (v3/v4), TypeScript and Tailwind CSS daily, plus JavaScript, React, Next.js, Angular, Vite, HTML and CSS. Services: Python, Django, Django REST, Go and PHP daily, plus FastAPI, NestJS and Node.js. Data: PostgreSQL and Redis daily, plus Meilisearch, RabbitMQ and Celery. Platform: Docker, Kubernetes (k3s), Linux and Git daily, plus ArgoCD, Nginx, Cloudflare, Hetzner, Vercel, Longhorn and Cert-Manager.

- [Home (Greek)](https://www.vasilistotskas.com/el): The same site in Greek; every page exists under /el

## Projects

- [Webside.gr](https://webside.gr): Production e-commerce store powered by GrooveShop, taking real orders since May 2026, running every layer on a self-hosted Hetzner k3s cluster with ArgoCD, Longhorn, RabbitMQ, Celery, Redis and Cert-Manager
- [GrooveShop demo](https://demo.grooveshop.space/): Live demo of the GrooveShop platform
- [GrooveShop docs](https://docs.grooveshop.space): Admin guide and developer documentation for the platform
- [GrooveShop API](https://github.com/vasilistotskas/grooveshop-django-api): Django REST backend — business logic, auth and data
- [GrooveShop storefront](https://github.com/vasilistotskas/grooveshop-storefront-ui-node-nuxt): Nuxt 4 storefront with SSR, proxying to the Django API through Nitro
- [GrooveShop media stream](https://github.com/vasilistotskas/grooveshop-media-stream): NestJS image processing and media delivery microservice
- [GrooveShop agent gateway](https://github.com/vasilistotskas/grooveshop-agent-gateway): Go service making every tenant storefront shoppable by AI agents over MCP, with UCP/ACP surfaces, product feeds and a chatbot backend
- [This portfolio](https://github.com/vasilistotskas/nextjs-portfolio): Next.js 16, React 19 and Tailwind v4 in two languages, with a WebGPU hero rendered through vgpu
